units.source_text: 源氏公子闭居邸内，寂寞无聊。

en.t: Prince Genji shut himself away inside his residence, lonely and bored.

units.source_text: 忽念槿姬平时虽然态度冷淡，但照她的性情推量起来，对公子今日悼亡的悲哀定然颇能理解，便写一封信给她。

en.t: He suddenly thought that although Princess Asagao was usually cool in manner, judging from her nature she would surely understand quite well the grief he felt today in mourning the dead, so he wrote her a letter.
By the time the letter arrived, dusk had already fallen.

units.source_text: 虽然近来久不通信了，但槿姬的侍女们知道以前也曾偶尔来信，并不引以为怪，便将信呈阅。

en.t: Although there had been no correspondence for a long while lately, Princess Asagao's attendants knew that letters had occasionally come before, so they did not find it strange and presented the letter to her.

units.source_text: 槿姬但见一张天蓝色的中国纸上写道：

en.t: Princess Asagao saw that on a sheet of sky-blue Chinese paper was written:
